description: A route handler renders user-controlled values directly into an HTML string returned via res.send, allowing stored/reflected cross-site scripting.
evidence:
src/routes/search.js:34 res.send(`

${name}

${digest}

`); — name and digest are interpolated into HTML with no escaping.
remediation: Escape both name and digest before interpolation, or render via a templating engine with auto-escaping enabled and set a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header. Validate and normalize inputs at the boundary.
title: HTML response embeds untrusted input without escaping

description: The pinned express@4.18.2 is affected by multiple known vulnerabilities (open redirect and XSS via response.redirect). Both advisories are remediated by upgrading to a current express 4.x release.
evidence: express@4.18.2 is affected by GHSA-rv95-896h-c2vc (CVE-2024-29041, open redirect) and GHSA-qw6h-vgh9-j6wx (CVE-2024-43796, XSS via response.redirect). pmg corroborates express<4.19.2 and express<4.20.0 ranges.
remediation: Upgrade express to a fixed 4.x release (>=4.22.2) and regenerate the lockfile. Run the dependency scanner again to confirm both advisories are cleared.
title: Outdated express dependency vulnerable to known advisories
